ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white/light grey) and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity regions localized on the distal portions of both lobes; central region from peduncle to notch is solid low-intensity; extensive low-intensity mottling and speckling is superimposed on the white distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees and a significant depth relative to the fluke vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude variations are inconsistent, showing several deep jagged indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges with a sharp upward taper toward the distal tips; trailing edge exhibits a slightly concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular pixel clusters detected; notably 4-6 ring-shaped marks in the central dark field and several scattered circular scars on both white lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel dark linear disruptions (rake marks) across the high-intensity field of the left lobe; multiple unaligned linear scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly spherical sessile organisms (barnacles) attached to the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark linear streak located near the tip of the right lobe, oriented diagonally against the white background.
